spec.description:
Rhino Wrap Breather is a Class 4 vapour permeable, Light Duty
flexible building membrane engineered for external walls. Manufactured by
laminating a microporous film between two layers of spunbonded non-woven
polyolefin, it allows internal water vapour to escape while acting as an
effective barrier to liquid water, draughts, and dust. It is designed to reduce
the risk of interstitial condensation in residential and commercial timber and
steel-framed wall assemblies.
features:
Class 4 vapour permeable allowing
water vapour to diffuse outward

Triple-layer spunbonded polyolefin and
microporous film laminate

Effective water barrier resisting liquid water
penetration
Air barrier reduces draughts and convective heat loss

Light
Duty mechanical classification to AS/NZS 4200.1

Resistant to mould and
bacterial degradation

Suitable for timber and steel framed wall
construction
Non-reflective surface eliminates installer glare on site

Low
Flammability Index compliant with AS 1530.2
spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable for external walls in
bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 to AS 3959
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC 2022 Volume One
and Two
spec.sustainability:
100% recyclable polyolefin materials; zero ODP;
non-toxic
install:
Install horizontally on the outer face of timber or
steel wall studs starting from the bottom plate

Fasten with broad-headed
galvanised clouts or staples at maximum 300mm centres

Ensure upper runs
overlap lower runs by at least 150mm to shed water downward

Overlap vertical
joins by minimum 150mm over a stud line

Tape all horizontal and vertical
joins using approved vapour-permeable acrylic cloth tape

Seal around window
and door openings and all service penetrations

Provide a ventilated drainage
cavity between the membrane and exterior cladding
selection_checklist: Verify climate zone requires a Class 4 vapour-permeable wall wrap

Confirm
external cladding type requires a drained cavity

Calculate total wall area
allowing minimum 150mm overlaps

Ensure compatible cloth or acrylic joining
tape is specified
Check installation exposure window prior to cladding
limitations:
Not designed for roof
sarking applications

Must not be left exposed to direct sunlight beyond
manufacturer UV limits

Ensure cladding provides an unobstructed drainage
cavity

use_cases:
Vapour-permeable wall wrap behind
residential brick veneer, timber weatherboards, and fibre cement in climate
zones 4 to 8

Air and moisture barrier over timber and steel wall framing to
assist with blower-door airtightness compliance

Weather barrier wrap behind
lightweight composite external cladding
retrieval.rag_summary:
Rhino Breathable Membrane (Rhino Wrap Breather) is
a Class 4 vapour-permeable, Light Duty pliable building membrane manufactured
from non-woven spunbonded polyolefin with a microporous core. Designed for
timber and steel-framed external walls, it allows interior moisture vapour to
diffuse freely while acting as a barrier against wind-driven rain, dust, and
draughts. Compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1:2017 and possessing a Flammability Index
≤ 5 (BAL-40 suitable), it mitigates condensation and mould in residential and
commercial wall assemblies.
